blind.description: An ornate wooden vanity/dressing table featuring four turned and carved legs, three front pull drawers with round knobs, patterned red-and-gold fabric drapes hanging along the sides beneath the tabletop, and an oval mirror framed with decorative woodwork mounted between two carved vertical posts. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular wooden tabletop with gently rounded corners, showing the top crest of the oval mirror and its two supporting side posts centered near the back edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: The mirror crest reaches about 4.5 feet tall (roughly chest-to-shoulder height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), with the tabletop at around 2.5 feet, and a total width of about 3.5 feet.
